Town Government

Contact your officials

Millbrook is governed by an elected five-member Select Board that appoints a professional Town Manager and oversees a representative Town Meeting form of government. The Select Board and Town Manager are supported by appointed boards and commissions whose members are residents serving on a volunteer basis.

Select Board meetings: 1st & 3rd Wednesdays, 6:00 p.m.
Office hours: By appointment — see each official below
Open Meeting Law: M.G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18–25

Elected Officials

Select Board

Five members, three-year staggered terms. Next election: April 6, 2027.

The Select Board is the chief executive body of the Town. It appoints the Town Manager, sets town policy, approves the warrant for Town Meeting, grants licenses and permits, and represents Millbrook in regional matters. Members are elected at-large by Millbrook voters and serve without salary.

CL

Catherine R. Lavoie

Chair, Select Board

Term: 2025–2028 · First elected 2019

Cathy Lavoie is a longtime Millbrook resident and former hospital administrator. She was first elected to the Select Board in 2019 and was selected as Chair by her colleagues in May 2025.

Top priorities this year

  • Complete Mill District zoning amendments and affordable-housing overlay
  • Stabilize FY27 budget without using rainy-day reserves
  • Secure federal funding for harbor dredging project

Chief Administrative Officer

Town Manager

Appointed by the Select Board under the 1976 Town Charter (as amended).

EW

Eleanor M. Whittaker

Town Manager · Appointed September 2023

Eleanor Whittaker is the chief administrative and financial officer of the Town of Millbrook. She is responsible for the day-to-day administration of all town departments, the development of the annual operating and capital budgets, the supervision of department heads, and the implementation of the policies adopted by the Select Board. She also serves as the Town’s chief procurement officer and labor negotiator.

Prior to joining Millbrook, she served as Assistant Town Administrator in a neighboring Bristol County municipality for eleven years and previously worked in municipal finance at the state Department of Revenue’s Division of Local Services. She holds an MPA from the University of Massachusetts and is a credentialed manager (ICMA-CM) of the International City/County Management Association.

Manager Whittaker holds office hours every Tuesday from 4:00 to 5:30 p.m. at Town Hall and is available by appointment at other times. She is the Town’s designated Records Access Officer for purposes of the Massachusetts Public Records Law.

Appointed Boards

Committees & commissions

Volunteer to serve →

Boards and commissions are populated by Millbrook residents who volunteer their time. Most members are appointed by the Select Board after recommendation by an open application process. Vacancies are posted publicly. New volunteers are always welcome — previous experience is helpful but not required.

About response times

Select Board members and the Town Manager aim to respond to all resident messages within 3–5 business days. Routine service requests (potholes, water bills, permits) are routed to the appropriate department for faster response. Communications regarding active legal matters or pending litigation may be referred to Town Counsel.

Messages sent through this form may be subject to disclosure under the Massachusetts Public Records Law. For urgent matters call (774) 555-0100 during business hours or 911 for emergencies.
